title: Guild Server Pulse Stats
summary: Guild settings now include a Server pulse analytics card with an at-a-glance view of server size and recent community activity.

highlights.title: Server Activity at a Glance
highlights.description: The card summarizes member count, messages, and new members over the last 14 days, with interactive views for message trends, member joins and departures, and the server's members, channels, and roles.

highlights.title: Community Analytics
highlights.description: Daily activity charts make it easier to spot changes in conversation and membership, with activity tracking noted from the time it is enabled.

items: Server pulse analytics card in guild settings
14-day daily message activity and member join/leave charts
Server layout view for member, channel, and role counts
